I also wonder if my friend would understand my reasons. If I explain that being around my ex is too triggering, he might respect that. It's possible that he would rather have me there in some capacity than not at all, even if I can't be a groomsman. In terms of morality, is it wrong to prioritize my mental health over attending a friend's wedding? I don't think so. This way, I'm being honest and showing that I care about him, even if I can't take on the role he's asking for.
